associations.rationale: The type only constructs PresentedAlgebra as a type from generators and relations; it does not itself state associativity or the group-algebra and enveloping-algebra parts of the complete source claim.
MonoidAlgebra is a broader monoid-algebra construction; it can support the group-algebra case but does not itself directly state that case.
The formal type is unavailable, so the declaration name alone cannot directly establish the universal-enveloping associative-algebra construction or the complete three-construction claim.
